verdict.rationale: Lithic is a REST API platform, so its core functionality (card issuance, transactions, webhooks, sandbox simulation) is inherently callable headlessly/programmatically, and the sandbox environment explicitly supports simulating transactions and webhooks end-to-end which could be scripted into CI pipelines. However, there is no explicit documentation of a CLI, CI/CD integration guide, or automation-testing workflow — the AI-native tooling shown (MCP server) is framed for interactive editor use (Cursor, Claude Code) rather than headless CI runs. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD or automated test-pipeline documentation, a CLI/headless mode, and evidence of the MCP server or sandbox being run non-interactively in automation.
